svg.title: Code Factory · isometric · SYNTHETIC DEMO
svg.desc: 52-week calendar grid of 10 unique observed event records across 5 repositories. This synthetic demo is a partial activity snapshot, not the official GitHub contribution calendar. Isometric or pixel factory machines represent the selected repositories. Events appear as coloured packages, and counts are recorded units rather than a count of commits.
svg.text: GitHub activity, built into a miniature world
Recorded event units · not official contribution totals
